title: SCP-3456, Orcadian Horseman
description: A creature that punishes those who have died too many times...
body:
The Orcadian Horseman adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-3456, also known as The Orcadian Horseman.


This large, horse-like creature appears only after a player has died multiple times. It possesses high speed, great strength, and projectile immunity. When distant, it fades into invisibility and reappears only when close enough to strike. During rain or thunder, SCP-3456 can even hide beneath the ground, waiting to ambush unsuspecting players who wander too close. Be careful how many times you die, or SCP-3456 will hunt you.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-3456 spawn?

SCP-3456 can spawn anywhere on the overworld surface like a normal monster. However SCP-3456 only spawns if a player has already died 3 times or more.

► How can I enable SCP-3456 to spawn?

SCP-3456 can be enabled instantly when setting the number of the gamerule "EnableOrcadianHorseman" to 1 or higher.

► How can I reset SCP-3456?

SCP-3456 can be reset by setting the number of the gamerule "EnableOrcadianHorseman" to 0.

To reset the Death Count of a player to trigger SCP-3456, you can use the command "/reset_orcadian_horseman"

</details>



![SCP-3456](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb79ece6a98eeb4613bc6e8ff058737f60761f6d.png)

SCP-3456 is a red, massive creature that resembles a horse with one or two human bodies fused together. It spawns only on the surface at night after a player has died three times. When targeting a player beyond 30 blocks, it becomes invisible, silently approaching until it’s close enough to attack. Within a 15-block radius, SCP-3456 can emit a loud shriek that shakes the ground, inflicts damage, and slows the victim. It can destroy blocks in its path like glass, wood or leaves. Fortunatly, SCP-3456 vanishes when coming in contact with water. If SCP-3456 kills an entity, there's a 30% chance for it to also vanishes. After a player’s fifth death, SCP-3456 may begin placing traps, becoming an even deadlier threat. Especially during rain or thunderstorms, when it hides beneath the ground, ready to strike without warning. If you see any weird shadows on the ground during rain or thunderstorms, it's better to stay away, since this means there is an SCP-3456 Instance burrowed into the ground.
